note: Nearest fire-insurance map to the 1900 census. May 1898, four sheets. Shop names on the Hurst brick block are the labels read on sheet 2. Where a 1898 label could not be read, the 1893 name is kept.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: The one-story dwelling at the Davis end of block 80, East Main side, is two stories on the May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, lot 316. The January 1886 and August 1893 sheets show that house as one story, so the old house is taken off and this one put in its place. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: A frame dwelling on lot 2 of block 72, the Crawford side, second lot from Hurst. The May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, shows a dwelling here. The August 1893 sheet shows the cigar factory and carpenter shop on this lot and does not show this house. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on the Dean side of block 81, lot 201, where the Excelsior Mills stood on the 1886 and 1893 sheets. May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2. Still there in March 1906. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: One-and-a-half-story frame dwelling on the Dean side of block 81, lot 201, beside the other new house. May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2. The mill is gone on this sheet. No family name is printed.

add.name: Home Steam Laundry
add.notes: May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 81, labeled Steam Laundry on the south edge of the old mill lots. The March 1906 sheet labels it Home Steam Laundry. The 1886 and 1893 sheets show the Excelsior Mills here instead.

update.name: H. H. Obenhauer & Co.
update.notes: May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 81. The mill the 1893 sheet called Excelsior is labeled H. H. Obenhauer & Co., machinery and a barn. The March 1906 sheet still prints that name.

update.name: Photo
update.notes: Hurst corner room of the brick block, May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72. The sheet labels this room Photo. The corner pediment and finial stay. The 1893 reading of this room was a market.

update.name: Groceries
update.notes: Second room west of Hurst, May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, labeled Gro.

update.name: Vacant
update.notes: May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72. This room of the brick block is labeled vacant.

update.name: Lunch
update.notes: May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, a room of the brick block labeled Lunch.

update.name: Saloon
update.notes: May 1898 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, a room of the brick block labeled Sal.
